abstract.text: Use the web map to find a place or inspect a coordinate.

inlineContent.text: Type a place or address in Search and choose a suggestion or result. The map moves to the selected place and shows its details when available. You can also enter a latitude and longitude pair, choose Show on map, and use Copy to share the coordinate text.
Search results are map places; your Project Locations remain available when you change the search selection.

abstract.text: Learn how LinkMap organizes shared places and work, use the iOS and web apps, and understand the implementation behind them.
Use the Project selector above the web map to choose the Project you want to view.
Use the iOS handbook to create and manage work in the native app. Use the web handbook to explore Projects and Locations in a browser and to understand the website implementation.
Explore your Projects and places in a browser.

The web app lets signed-in users explore Projects and Locations, while search and coordinate inspection work independently of iCloud sign-in. This branch contains the browser guide and the implementation and deployment notes.
